newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Cockerill's Ymos sells div to Valeo.
newsitem.headline: Cockerill's Ymos sells div to Valeo.

text.p: Belgium's Groupe Cockerill Sambre said on Monday its German unit Ymos had sold its locking systems division to French group Valeo.
The locking systems division had sales of six billion Belgian francs in 1995 and employs 1,400 staff in five plants - two in France, one in Germany, one in Great Britain and one in Spain.
The sale would enable Ymos to concentrate on its core businesses - metals and plastics composites for cars built in Europe, Cockerill, which owns 95.15 percent of Ymos, said in a statement.
The deal also reinforced Ymos's financial structure and allowed it to pursue its restructuring programme and improve competitiveness.
Cockerill did not give a selling price for the division.
